comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling homes to consumers with mortgage and title services; not a lot developer selling finished lots to builders.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Mostly a homebuilder with mortgage, title and rental operations; it is Forestar's parent and customer, not a pure lot developer.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Production homebuilder selling homes to consumers; it buys lots, whereas Forestar develops and sells them.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Develops residential land into finished lots, including sales to third-party builders, though it also builds homes itself.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling to consumers with design studios and mortgage services; it is a lot buyer, not a developer.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Option-lot homebuilder with mortgage banking; it buys finished lots, the opposite side of Forestar's business.
